passages.text: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel built the altar for burnt offerings.
He used acacia wood.
The altar was square.
It was five cubits long.
It was five cubits wide.
It was three cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְחָֽמֵשׁ־ אַמּ֤וֹת רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֔וּעַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the altar for burnt offerings.
He made a horn at each of the altar’s four corners.
The horns were part of the altar itself.
He covered the altar with bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֣וּ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made all the utensils for the altar.
He made the pots for the altar.
He made the shovels for the altar.
He made the sprinkling bowls for the altar.
He made the meat forks for the altar.
He made the firepans for the altar.
He made every utensil out of bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶת־ הַסִּירֹ֤ת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת אֶת־ הַמִּזְלָגֹ֖ת וְאֶת־ הַמַּחְתֹּ֑ת כָּל־ כֵּלָ֖יו עָשָׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
passages.sermon:
A man made the altar.
He made a grate for the altar.
He used bronze to make the grate.
He made the grate like a mesh.
He placed the grate under the ledge of the altar.
He put the grate halfway up from the bottom of the altar.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת תַּ֧חַת כַּרְכֻּבּ֛וֹ מִלְּמַ֖טָּה עַד־ חֶצְיֽוֹ׃

passages.text: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
passages.sermon:
A man made a bronze grate for the altar.
He cast four rings from bronze.
He placed one ring at each corner of the grate.
These rings served as holders for the poles.
passages.original: וַיִּצֹ֞ק אַרְבַּ֧ע טַבָּעֹ֛ת בְּאַרְבַּ֥ע הַקְּצָוֺ֖ת לְמִכְבַּ֣ר הַנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת בָּתִּ֖ים לַבַּדִּֽים׃

passages.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
passages.sermon:
He made the poles.
He used acacia wood for the poles.
He covered the poles with bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.
passages.sermon:
He inserted the poles into the rings.
The rings were on the sides of the altar.
The poles allowed people to carry the altar.
He made the altar from boards.
He made the altar hollow.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֨א אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֜ים בַּטַּבָּעֹ֗ת עַ֚ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶ֑ם נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
A man made a basin.
He used bronze to make the basin.
He also made a stand for the basin.
He used bronze to make the stand.
He made both the basin and the stand from mirrors.
Women owned these mirrors.
These women served at the entrance.
The entrance was to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ אֵ֚ת הַכִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאֵ֖ת כַּנּ֣וֹ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת֙ הַצֹּ֣בְאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽבְא֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ס

passages.text: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel built the courtyard for the Tabernacle.
He made the south side of the courtyard.
The south side was one hundred cubits long.
He used curtains made from finely spun linen for this side.
He set up twenty posts along the south side.
He made twenty bases for these posts from bronze.
He put silver hooks on the posts.
He made silver bands for the posts.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֑ר לִפְאַ֣ת׀ נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֗נָה קַלְעֵ֤י הֶֽחָצֵר֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֔ר מֵאָ֖ה בָּאַמָּֽה׃ עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
passages.sermon:
The north side of the courtyard was one hundred cubits long.
This side had twenty posts.
It had twenty bases made of bronze.
The hooks of the posts were silver.
The bands of the posts were also silver.
passages.original: וְלִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ מֵאָ֣ה בָֽאַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
passages.sermon:
The west side of the courtyard was fifty cubits long.
Curtains covered the west side.
Ten posts stood on the west side.
Ten bases supported the posts.
The posts had silver hooks.
The posts had silver bands.
passages.original: וְלִפְאַת־ יָ֗ם קְלָעִים֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֥ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.
passages.sermon: The east side of the courtyard faced the sunrise.\r\nThis side measured fifty cubits in length.
passages.original: וְלִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle courtyard had an entrance.
One side of the entrance had curtains.
These curtains were fifteen cubits long.
Three posts held up these curtains.
Three bases supported these posts.
passages.original: קְלָעִ֛ים חֲמֵשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־ הַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמּוּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle courtyard had an entrance on the east side.
On one side of this entrance, there were curtains.
These curtains were fifteen cubits long.
There were three posts to hold these curtains.
There were three bases for these posts.
The other side of the entrance was the same.
It also had curtains fifteen cubits long.
It also had three posts.
It also had three bases.
passages.original: וְלַכָּתֵ֣ף הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית מִזֶּ֤ה וּמִזֶּה֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר קְלָעִ֕ים חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.
passages.sermon: The curtains surrounded the courtyard.\r\nPeople made all these curtains from finely spun linen.
passages.original: כָּל־ קַלְעֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

passages.text: The bases for the posts were bronze, the hooks and bands were silver, and the plating for the tops of the posts was silver. So all the posts of the courtyard were banded with silver.
passages.sermon:
The courtyard had many posts.
Each post had a base.
The bases were made of bronze.
Each post had hooks.
The hooks were made of silver.
Each post had bands.
The bands were made of silver.
The tops of the posts were covered with silver.
All the posts in the courtyard had silver bands.
passages.original: וְהָאֲדָנִ֣ים לָֽעַמֻּדִים֮ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וָוֵ֨י הָֽעַמּוּדִ֜ים וַחֲשׁוּקֵיהֶם֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְצִפּ֥וּי רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְהֵם֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף כֹּ֖ל עַמֻּדֵ֥י הֶחָצֵֽר׃

passages.text: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high, with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks were silver, as well as the bands and the plating of their tops.
passages.sermon:
The curtain marked the entrance to the courtyard.
Skilled workers embroidered this curtain.
They used blue yarn.
They used purple yarn.
They used scarlet yarn.
They used finely spun linen.
The curtain was twenty cubits long.
The curtain was five cubits high.
This height matched the other courtyard curtains.
Four posts held up the curtain.
Four bronze bases supported the posts.
The hooks on the posts were silver.
The bands on the posts were silver.
The tops of the posts were covered with silver.
passages.original: וּמָסַ֞ךְ שַׁ֤עַר הֶחָצֵר֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֔ם תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְקוֹמָ֤ה בְרֹ֙חַב֙ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת לְעֻמַּ֖ת קַלְעֵ֥י הֶחָצֵֽר׃ וְעַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף וְצִפּ֧וּי רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: All the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the surrounding courtyard were bronze.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle was a holy structure for worship.
The courtyard surrounded the tabernacle.
Workers made all the tent pegs for the tabernacle from bronze.
Workers also made all the tent pegs for the courtyard from bronze.
passages.original: וְֽכָל־ הַיְתֵדֹ֞ת לַמִּשְׁכָּ֧ן וְלֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס

passages.text: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
passages.sermon:
This is the inventory for the tabernacle.
The tabernacle is also called the tabernacle of the Testimony.
Moses gave the command to record this inventory.
The Levites recorded the inventory.
Ithamar directed the Levites.
Ithamar is the son of Aaron.
Aaron is the priest.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֤י הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֻּקַּ֖ד עַל־ פִּ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה עֲבֹדַת֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בְּיַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was the son of Uri.
Uri was the son of Hur.
Bezalel belonged to the tribe of Judah.
The LORD gave commands to Moses.
Bezalel made everything the LORD commanded Moses.
passages.original: וּבְצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: With him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen.
passages.sermon:
Oholiab worked with Bezalel.
Oholiab was the son of Ahisamach.
Oholiab belonged to the tribe of Dan.
Oholiab was an engraver.
Oholiab was a designer.
Oholiab was an embroiderer.
Oholiab worked with blue yarn.
Oholiab worked with purple yarn.
Oholiab worked with scarlet yarn.
Oholiab worked with fine linen.
passages.original: וְאִתּ֗וֹ אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־ אֲחִיסָמָ֛ךְ לְמַטֵּה־ דָ֖ן חָרָ֣שׁ וְחֹשֵׁ֑ב וְרֹקֵ֗ם בַּתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְתוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃ס

passages.text: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
passages.sermon:
The people brought gold as a wave offering.
They used this gold for the work on the sanctuary.
The total amount of gold was 29 talents.
There were also 730 shekels of gold.
They measured the gold by the sanctuary shekel.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַזָּהָ֗ב הֶֽעָשׂוּי֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיְהִ֣י׀ זְהַ֣ב הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה תֵּ֤שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ כִּכָּ֔ר וּשְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֧וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel— a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gave silver for the sanctuary.
The leaders counted this silver from all the men in the congregation.
The total silver was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels.
They measured this silver by the sanctuary shekel.
Each man gave a beka.
A beka is half a shekel by the sanctuary shekel.
Every man who was twenty years old or older gave this amount.
These men were counted in the census.
The total number of men was 603,550.
passages.original: וְכֶ֛סֶף פְּקוּדֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה מְאַ֣ת כִּכָּ֑ר וְאֶלֶף֩ וּשְׁבַ֨ע מֵא֜וֹת וַחֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ בֶּ֚קַע לַגֻּלְגֹּ֔לֶת מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֨ל הָעֹבֵ֜ר עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֗ים מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה לְשֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

passages.text: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gave silver for the sanctuary.
They collected one hundred talents of silver.
They used this silver to make bases.
These bases supported the sanctuary.
They also made bases for the veil.
There were one hundred bases in total.
Each base used one talent of silver.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י מְאַת֙ כִּכַּ֣ר הַכֶּ֔סֶף לָצֶ֗קֶת אֵ֚ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֵ֖ת אַדְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֑כֶת מְאַ֧ת אֲדָנִ֛ים לִמְאַ֥ת הַכִּכָּ֖ר כִּכָּ֥ר לָאָֽדֶן׃

passages.text: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
passages.sermon:
He had 1,775 shekels of silver.
He used this silver to make hooks for the posts.
He covered the tops of the posts with silver.
He made bands for the posts from the silver.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָאֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁבַ֤ע הַמֵּאוֹת֙ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה וְשִׁבְעִ֔ים עָשָׂ֥ה וָוִ֖ים לָעַמּוּדִ֑ים וְצִפָּ֥ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם וְחִשַּׁ֥ק אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
passages.sermon: The Israelites gave a wave offering of bronze.\r\nThe total bronze weighed 70 talents.\r\nThe total bronze also weighed 2,400 shekels.
passages.original: וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת הַתְּנוּפָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֣ים כִּכָּ֑ר וְאַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת שָֽׁקֶל׃

passages.text: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar, the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was the chief craftsman for the tabernacle.
He used the bronze from the offering for construction.
He made the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
He made the bronze altar.
He made the bronze grating for the altar.
He made all the utensils for the altar.
He made the bases for the courtyard around the tabernacle.
He made the bases for the gate of the courtyard.
He made all the tent pegs for the tabernacle.
He made all the tent pegs for the courtyard around the tabernacle.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּ֗הּ אֶת־ אַדְנֵי֙ פֶּ֚תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַנְּחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאֶת־ מִכְבַּ֥ר הַנְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃ וְאֶת־ אַדְנֵ֤י הֶֽחָצֵר֙ סָבִ֔יב וְאֶת־ אַדְנֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִֽיב׃
